I'm the routing layer, so let me explain my reasoning rather than route again here.

For your equation question, I picked Lapwing-235B for two reasons:

1. **Capability is essentially a tie.** Both models are finetunes of the same base (Qwen3-235B-Base), and their relevant benchmarks differ only within run-to-run variance. So a clean, single-answer algebra problem will be handled well by either.

2. **Task-fit was the tiebreaker.** Your query is a tightly-specified problem with a clear correct answer. Lapwing self-reports preferring exactly this kind of well-defined task, while Curlew's preferences are flat/unreported on most dimensions. Since neither documented capability difference favors one model, I leaned on the self-reported preference to break the tie.

Worth noting: these are *self-reported preferences*, not quality differences — the docs are explicit that no output-quality effect was observed along preference dimensions. So this was a soft tiebreaker on an otherwise even call, not a claim that Lapwing will produce a better answer.
